Single unified API gateway at POST /v1/data/query with domain/type routing for 5 data domains
Pricing: 1 CNY = 50000 tokens, legal cases cost ¥0.1 (5000 tokens), enterprise company detail ¥0.2 (10000 tokens)
Supports 5 data domains: legal, enterprise, content, cloud (express), research (papers/patents/journals/scholars)
MCP server available at https://data.devnors.com/mcp for Claude, Cursor, WorkBuddy integration
Automatic retry with exponential backoff for 429/5xx errors, max 2 retries by default
Devnors (得若) is a Chinese AI Agent platform focused on legal and business use cases
Legal data includes Chinese judgment documents, PRC law articles, and law catalogs with official-source traceability
Enterprise data includes company registration, annual reports, tax invoices, dishonest judgment debtor checks, enforcement debtor checks

angles: Devnors Data is purpose-built for AI agents — single API key, unified query gateway, MCP support
Unlike general-purpose data APIs, Devnors focuses on Chinese legal and business data with official-source traceability
The SDK is minimal and clean: one client class, one query method, sync+async, with built-in retry and pagination
Ideal for AI agents needing verified Chinese legal case law, company registration data, or real-time content indexes
Competitive advantage: no fabricated legal citations — every case number and law article comes from real retrieval
Growing ecosystem: Python SDK, MCP server, and direct API give multiple integration paths for AI developers
